annotations.ru:
<image>
На основе структурной схемы управления или эквивалентной схемы на изображении представьте аннотацию в форме дифференциально-алгебраических уравнений (DAE) для динамического моделирования, включая блоки управления, входы, состояния, выходы, дифференциальные и алгебраические уравнения.

<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["DC-voltage outer PI controller","AC-voltage outer PI controller","dq current PI controllers","Cross-current and voltage feedforward","Inverse Park and Clarke transformation"],"inputs":["U_dc_avg","U_dcn","U_s","U_s_ref","i_nd","i_nq","u_cnd","u_cnq","theta (selected external frame-context input)"],"states":["phi_od","phi_oq","phi_id","phi_iq"],"outputs":["u_na_ref","u_nb_ref","u_nc_ref"],"differential_equations":["dphi_od/dt=Ki_od*e_od","dphi_oq/dt=Ki_oq*e_oq","dphi_id/dt=Ki_id*e_id","dphi_iq/dt=Ki_iq*e_iq"],"algebraic_equations":["e_od=U_dc_avg-U_dcn","e_oq=U_s-U_s_ref","e_id=i_d_ref-i_nd","e_iq=i_q_ref-i_nq","i_d_ref=Kp_od*e_od+phi_od","i_q_ref=Kp_oq*e_oq+phi_oq","y_d=Kp_id*e_id+phi_id","y_q=Kp_iq*e_iq+phi_iq","v_d_cmd=-y_d+u_cnd+omega*L*i_nq","v_q_cmd=-y_q+u_cnq-omega*L*i_nd","u_alpha_ref=cos(theta)*v_d_cmd-sin(theta)*v_q_cmd","u_beta_ref=sin(theta)*v_d_cmd+cos(theta)*v_q_cmd","u_na_ref=u_alpha_ref","u_nb_ref=-u_alpha_ref/2+sqrt(3)*u_beta_ref/2","u_nc_ref=-u_alpha_ref/2-sqrt(3)*u_beta_ref/2"],"notes":"phi_od,phi_oq,phi_id,phi_iq are outer/inner dq PI integral contributions with finite symbolic gains, nonzero generic integral gains and finite independent initials. The selected inverse Park/Clarke transform is amplitude-invariant with unit scaling and zero output zero sequence. theta is external frame context; omega fixed compensation frequency and L>0. All voltage/current measurements are external. Outer q error is measured-minus-reference; both inner PI outputs enter commands negatively."}

Based on the control/equivalent block diagram in the image, provide DAE annotations for dynamic modeling, including control units, inputs, states, outputs, differential equations, and algebraic equations.
annotations.es:
<image>
A partir del diagrama de bloques de control o equivalente de la imagen, proporciona anotaciones DAE para el modelado dinámico, incluidas las unidades de control, las entradas, los estados, las salidas, las ecuaciones diferenciales y las ecuaciones algebraicas.
annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.
